The long pinkish strips lack logical continuity; they twist unnaturally, change width abruptly, and seem to emerge from or disappear into other vegetables without a clear source or end point.
The skin texture has a 'smudged' or painterly quality rather than crisp botanical detail. The transition between light and shadow on the curve is overly soft and lacks micro-texture.
The rim of the white plate warps slightly inconsistently, suggesting minor geometric instability in the background structure.
